Mercury-1D.name: Mercury-1D
Mercury-1D.form_factor: Extended OAM-L Liquid Module (140 x 185 mm)

failure_reasons: Die 1 failed ATE binning: 75/84 SCCs survived (< 76 required)

decode_b1.bottleneck: GDDR7 memory bandwidth bound (~3.07 TB/s vs H200 4.8 TB/s & B200 8.0 TB/s)

failure_reasons: PCIe degraded link width: Gen5 x8 (expected x16)
Scale-out port degradation: 3/4 x 400GbE links active

optimization.change: SCC tile 128x128 -> 256x128 plus NoC A-operand multicast per die grid row
optimization.metric: achieved FP8 TFLOPS (whole SKU) over k_groups x K=128

complexity_cost.unmodeled: NoC replication buffers, router area/power, multicast flow control

config.fp64_ops: RMSNorm, softmax/SDPA internals, SiLU, AdamW update

attribution.note: Same FP8 bytes on all FP8 paths. End-to-end drift vs FP64 is set by FP8 quantization (~27% of the 20-step update norm on this outlier stress case), and multi-step AdamW trajectories decorrelate, so end-to-end Hopper vs Mercury differences are noise. The accumulator signal is the *_vs_fp8_exact_accum metrics.
